question.worked_solution:
For compatible matrices $A,$ $B,$ and $C,$ and scalar $\alpha ,$ the Hadamard product has the following properties:

- Commutativity:

$$
A⊙B=B⊙A
$$

- Associativity:

$$
(A⊙B)⊙C=A⊙(B⊙C)
$$

- Distributivity over Addition:

$$
A⊙(B+C)=A⊙B+A⊙C
$$

- Scalar Distributivity:

$$
\alpha (A⊙B)=(\alpha A)⊙B=A⊙(\alpha B)
$$

In this case, by the distributivity over the addition of the Hadamard product, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}A⊙(B+C) & =A⊙B+A⊙C \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 \\ 3 & -2\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}5 & -3 \\ 2 & 6\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1+5 & 4+(-3) \\ 3+2 & -2+6\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4 & 1 \\ 5 & 4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
